mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of future monetary policy accommodation and reduces inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and triggers a risk-on rally in equities over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint HOUST and RSAFS contraction episodes (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of monetary policy easing and triggers positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days due to rapid market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO contraction episodes (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 270.0 within a 1-month window signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand momentum, which increases the probability of sustained economic expansion and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during joint RSAFS and HOUST expansion episodes (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% combined with a strong gain in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month signals labor market overheating, which increases the likelihood of imminent monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint UNRATE drop and PAYEMS surge (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to generate negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, as measured by the latest available data, indicates a recessionary environment, which increases the probability of aggressive fiscal and monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to policy-driven recovery expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during GDPC1 contraction periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.
